attach(data)

# Define server logic

  #Filter based on Selection

messages.subject: Re: Interactive Radarchart in Shiny assistance
parts: "by the selected item from the data table"

do you mean scenario where user clicks on a row/s on datatable and the selected row/s data are sent to ChartJSRadar()?
or
chartJSRadar() uses data which are filtered by your selectInputs and sliderInput (thus the same as your datatable)?
Rgds,
Peter
